const counter = {
  [Symbol.iterator]() {
    let i = 0;
    return { next() { return { value: i, done: i++ >= 2 }; } };
  },
};
for (const n of counter) console.log(n.toFixed(1));
class Steps {
  [Symbol.iterator]() {
    let i = 0;
    return { next: () => ({ value: `v${i}`, done: i++ >= 1 }) };
  }
}
console.log([...new Steps()].map((s) => s.toUpperCase()));
